name: Kanojo * Step
source:
The protagonist has moved too many times to count and this time, he has ended up in his grandmother’s minshuku located in Shirasagi, a rural town situated near the mountains. His sister told him that this was their last move, and after he graduates from school, he will be free to do as he wishes. After suppressing his feelings of love until now, he sets out to pursue his first love.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/09/27/september-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
主人公已经搬家无数次了，这一次，他来到了祖母的民宿，位于靠近山脉的乡村小镇白鹭。姐姐告诉他，这是他们最后的举动，等他毕业后，他就可以自由地做自己想做的事了。在压抑至今的爱情之后，他开始追求他的初恋。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/09/27/september-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
